action.description: Defined by risk, stakes, fight scenes, stunts, car chases, and general danger.

heroic_bloodshed.definition: Focuses on duty, brotherhood, honor, redemption, and the protection of the vulnerable.

military_action.definition: Focuses on military exploits where events are framed as entertaining rather than tragic.

espionage.definition: High excitement and entertainment focus on spies, rather than political realism.

wuxia.definition: Martial arts as both excitement and a chivalrous act of protection and honor.

cyberpunk_action.definition: High-tech combat in a dystopian society involving cybernetics and AI.

disaster.definition: Characters trying to survive large-scale destruction from naturally occurring events.

sci_fi.description: Speculation and science. Uses technology, space, biology, energy, and time as central elements.

post_apocalyptic.definition: Based around the struggle generated by a world-ending event.

utopian.definition: An idyllic world without hunger or homelessness, revealing conflict in perfection.

cyberpunk.definition: High-tech low-life. Desperate society oversaturated with crime and cybernetics.

tech_noir.definition: Technology itself is the source of humanity's struggle/downfall.

space_opera.definition: Space warfare, adventure, and romance on a grand scale.

contemporary_scifi.definition: Set in the present day, introducing theoretical technology as the main source of conflict.

horror.description: Designed to elicit fear, terror, and macabre entertainment.

cosmic_horror.definition: Fear of the unknown and the insignificance of humanity against ancient powers.

slasher.definition: Antagonist stalks and murders a group of people.

psychological_horror.definition: Reliability of the protagonist is questioned; fear comes from the mind.

folk_horror.definition: Horror derived from rural traditions, cults, and nature.

found_footage.definition: Simulates real-life informal recordings of horrific events.

thriller.description: Generated suspense, anxiety, and strong emotions.

techno_thriller.definition: Conflict takes place through detailed technical aspects and espionage.

neo_noir.definition: Modern update to film noir with cynical attitudes and sexual motivations.

psychological_thriller.definition: Emphasizes unstable mental states and gaslighting.

western.description: Set in the American West (19th Century) or space equivalents.

classic_western.definition: Traditional frontier struggle, lawlessness, and expansion.

space_western.definition: Western tropes applied to a sci-fi frontier setting.

revisionist_western.definition: Challenges or disproves the myths/tropes of traditional westerns.

crime.description: Deals with the criminal justice system, moral gray areas, criminals, and law enforcement.

heist.definition: Professionals navigating obstacles to steal something valuable.

gangster.definition: Explores the world and hierarchy of organized crime.

detective.definition: Follows an investigator pursuing clues to a specific case.

whydunit.definition: Focuses on the motive rather than the perpetrator.

fantasy.description: Uses magic, supernatural elements, and fictional universes.

high_fantasy.definition: Epic stakes, entirely fictional worlds, magic is common.

urban_fantasy.definition: Magic exists secretly within the modern world.

dark_fantasy.definition: Fantasy elements in a hostile, frightening world.

dark_comedy.definition: Uses objectionable or morbid events to create humor.

mockumentary.definition: Uses documentary format to mock specific subjects.
examples: What We Do in the Shadows

satire.definition: Mocks overall ideas, vices, or institutions.

drama.description: Focuses on conflict, emotion, and reality.

period_drama.definition: Set in a specific historical era with accurate details.

docudrama.definition: Recreates real-life events with high accuracy.

experimental.description: Does not fit into a particular genre.

surrealist.definition: Uses irrational imagery to activate the subconscious.

absurdist.definition: Characters experience situations suggesting no central purpose to life.
